utils.report_exporter module¶

Report exporter — builds downloadable Markdown reports from chat sessions.

utils.report_exporter.build_markdown_report(summary: str | None, chat_history: list[dict[str, Any]], stats: dict[str, Any], data_source: str | None = None) → str[source]¶

Build a Markdown report from the current session.

Includes dataset overview, AI summary (if available), and Q&A with embedded chart PNGs (if kaleido is installed).
